title: Singh Is Kinng
desc: Happy, notoriously famous for his antics, is sent to fetch Lakhan so that he can meet his ailing father. But, in Australia, Happy ends up taking Lakhan's place as the king of the local underworld.

title: Game Changer
desc: A principled IAS officer battles systemic corruption, championing fair elections to uphold democratic integrity amidst political machinations.

title: RRR
desc: A fearless revolutionary and an officer in the British force, both of whom once shared a deep bond, decide to join forces against despotic rulers.

title: Vijaypath
desc: When a criminal is sentenced to death by Judge Saxena, the gangster's brother takes revenge by killing the judge's family and his driver. Later, the driver's son embarks on a vengeful quest.

title: Badal
desc: Badal's family dies at the hands of a corrupt police officer. While he is raised by his father's friend, he turns into a terrorist and vows to avenge his family's death.
